dataset.name: Brescia high-grade serous ovarian cancer cohort (GSE291288)
dataset.description: Independent high-grade serous ovarian cancer cohort with fresh-frozen primary-tumor bulk RNA-seq and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: The Brescia cohort contains 139 patients with high-grade serous ovarian cancer. All patients contribute one fresh-frozen bulk tumor, exact vital status and follow-up time; 131 of 139 have FIGO stage III or IV disease.
dataset.publication_citation: Rai et al. Clinical Cancer Research 2026

metadata.source_data_system: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus and Code Ocean verified capsule
metadata.library_method: NEBNext Ultra II RNA library preparation and paired-end sequencing; Trim Galore preprocessing; Kallisto 0.46.2 quantification against Ensembl release 75; tximport 1.14.2 gene-level summarization
metadata.endpoint_caveat: The verified analysis capsule labels Time in years and Event as all-cause death/censoring but does not state a more precise clinical day-zero. TRACE Explorer preserves the source interval and does not reinterpret it as TCGA-CDR OS.
metadata.clinical_evidence_note: The peer-reviewed article states that the Brescia cohort was selected for clinical-data availability. Its verified Code Ocean capsule exposes the exact BSSurvivalData.csv used by the published Cox and Kaplan-Meier analyses. The capsule record is identified by Code Ocean ID 8ff8a82d-53c6-422f-8111-c9332e8b9bf6 and DOI 10.24433/CO.4397505.v1.
metadata.sample_linkage_note: Each GEO bulk-tumor sample records its internal R-number twice in the sample descriptions. The clinical table uses the corresponding BS-number. All 139 R-number and BS-number keys match one-to-one, including the four nonconsecutive identifiers.
metadata.expression_curation_note: The GEO filename describes the matrix as TPM, but the deposited matrix has counts.R sample headers, non-integer tximport abundance values and per-library totals of approximately 29-40 million rather than one million. TRACE Explorer therefore treats it as the source tximport estimated-count component, computes CPM over all 28,175 unique source symbols and applies log2(CPM + 1).
metadata.stage_coding_note: The source analysis table codes FIGO stage I/II as 0 and stage III/IV as 1. The published Table 1 confirms 8 early-stage and 131 advanced-stage patients.
metadata.residual_tumor_note: The source RT field codes no visible postoperative residual tumor as 0 and visible residual tumor as 1. It is retained in the auditable source clinical record but is not promoted as a generic stage or grade field.
metadata.overlap_note: The institutionally defined Brescia cohort is external to TCGA-OV and to the previously registered multicenter, Cedars-Sinai and CHA ovarian releases.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the public GEO matrix and verified Code Ocean clinical file in place. Direct redistribution remains disabled under the conservative repository policy.

samples.sample_role: Fresh-frozen primary high-grade serous ovarian tumor

expression.label: GEO tximport abundance normalized as log2(CPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Source-provided gene symbols from Ensembl release 75 transcript quantification summarized by tximport
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: All 28,175 non-empty source symbols are unique under case-normalized comparison; no implicit aggregation is applied.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer computes CPM from all 28,175 source rows in each selected tumor and applies log2(CPM + 1). Values support within-cohort relative analysis and are not cross-study normalized.

endpoints.label: Source-provided overall survival
endpoints.time_origin: Source study baseline; the exact day-zero definition is not specified in the public capsule
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause as encoded by the source Event field
